value.rationale: Full preservation of every ecological function is a natural robustness event. Ranking reversals across extinction budgets invalidate a single universal ranking even under matching species/function counts. A sharp first cutoff, complete first-layer classification, and unbounded four-function family identify a precise, motivated structural boundary rather than an arbitrary isolated computation.
